hooks.command: input=$(printf '%s' "${CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT:-}" | python3 -c 'import sys,json;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print(d.get("command",""))') || { echo 'BLOCKED: Failed to parse tool input.' >&2; exit 1; }; if [ -z "$input" ]; then echo 'BLOCKED: Failed to read tool input.' >&2; exit 1; fi; if printf '%s' "$input" | grep -qE 'push.+main|push.+master'; then echo 'BLOCKED: Direct push to main/master is not allowed. Use a feature branch.' >&2; exit 1; fi

file=$(printf '%s' "${CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT:-}" | python3 -c 'import sys,json;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print(d.get("path",d.get("file_path","")))') || { echo 'BLOCKED: Failed to parse tool input.' >&2; exit 1; }; if [ -z "$file" ]; then echo 'BLOCKED: Failed to read tool input.' >&2; exit 1; fi; if printf '%s' "$file" | grep -qE '\.env$|\.env\.'; then echo 'BLOCKED: Writing to .env files is not allowed. Use environment variables or secrets manager.' >&2; exit 1; fi

if ! git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'BLOCKED: Not inside a git work tree. Create and switch to a feature branch first: git checkout -b feature/SCRUM-{id}-{slug}' >&2; exit 1; fi; branch=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null) || branch=''; if [ -z "$branch" ]; then echo 'BLOCKED: Detached HEAD or git unavailable. Create and switch to a feature branch first: git checkout -b feature/SCRUM-{id}-{slug}' >&2; exit 1; fi; if [ "$branch" = "main" ] || [ "$branch" = "master" ]; then echo "BLOCKED: You are on '$branch'. Create and switch to a feature branch first: git checkout -b feature/SCRUM-{id}-{slug}" >&2; exit 1; fi

file=$(printf '%s' "${CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT:-}" | python3 -c 'import sys,json;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print(d.get("path",d.get("file_path","")))') || exit 0; if [ -z "$file" ]; then exit 0; fi; if [ -f "$file" ] && grep -qEi '(password|passwd|pwd|token|secret|api[_-]?key|secret[_-]?key|secret[_-]?access[_-]?key|private[_-]?key|access[_-]?token|client[_-]?secret|jwt[_-]?secret|aws[_-]?secret[_-]?access[_-]?key|github[_-]?token)[[:space:]]*[:=][[:space:]]*["'\'']?[A-Za-z0-9_@$%^&*#!./-]+' "$file" 2>/dev/null; then echo "WARNING: Possible hardcoded credential detected in $file. Review before committing." >&2; fi
